sources: Curated build metadata (PLAN.md sections 5, 7). Clip names are the human-readable names LanternExtractor emits for classic EQ animation clips; candidates are listed in priority order and the first one present in the uploaded model is used. Frame fractions are provisional and tuned visually for how each reads as a frozen figurine.

poses.label: Standing
poses.notes: Safe default; compact and balanced, the most printable pose.

poses.label: Waving
poses.notes: One arm raised; introduces an overhang and a small balance shift.

poses.label: Saluting
poses.notes: Arm to head; watch the hand does not fuse to the face on remesh.

poses.label: Bowing
poses.notes: Social greeting; a stable, self-supporting pose.

poses.label: Attacking
poses.notes: Weapon extended; long overhang and a thin blade — usually wants a base.

poses.label: Casting
poses.notes: Arms out; dramatic but the hardest to print (overhangs, balance).

poses.label: Idle (arms at sides)
poses.notes: Relaxed neutral stance; the most compact, lowest-risk silhouette.

poses.label: Sitting
poses.notes: Seated; very stable footprint but needs a flat surface beneath it.

poses.label: Kneeling
poses.notes: One knee down; broad, stable contact with the ground.

poses.label: Two-handed swing
poses.notes: Big two-handed wind-up; wide pose, almost always wants a base.

poses.label: Kick
poses.notes: Dynamic one-leg pose; needs a base to stand — high tip risk.

poses.label: Archery
poses.notes: Drawn bow; arms span wide, watch the string/arrow as thin features.

poses.label: Cheering
poses.notes: Both arms up; tall overhangs but a fun, expressive figurine.

poses.label: Mourning
poses.notes: Head bowed, hands up; compact and self-supporting.

poses.label: Nodding
poses.notes: Subtle head tilt; reads as a calm portrait pose, very printable.
